description: Execute a language-server operation against the warm LSP pool for a plan's worktree or the main checkout.

plan_id.description: Plan scope identifying the target worktree, or the literal NO_PLAN for the main checkout of the workspace scope (refused for rename, server-enforced).

path.description: Repository-relative file path within the plan's worktree (required for document_symbol, definition, references, hover, diagnostics, rename; a '..' segment or a path resolving outside the worktree is refused with invalid_arguments).

line.description: 1-based line number (required for definition, references, hover, rename).

character.description: 1-based column counted in Unicode code points of the line (required for definition, references, hover, rename); the server converts to the language server's negotiated position encoding.
